_source: Google reviews as published on the client's own page https://aarushsuzuki.in/reviews/ (all rated 5 out of 5). Text kept as written; only spacing, capitalisation and a truncated ending were tidied. Add new reviews only from the Google Business Profile.

items.name: Faisal Rak
items.text: Nikita Singh was very supportive. She supported us in giving the particular colour we needed in very less time. Even Ahmed sir, the finance guy, was also helpful. Our overall experience was great in this showroom. Highly recommended.

items.name: Swagat Reddy
items.text: I gave my bike for service around 10 AM in the morning. Shaukat, the advisor over there, understood the condition and advised me accordingly. I am very happy with the service provided.

items.name: Sainath Trivedi
items.text: Good customer experience. Well behaved staff. Thanks Sadiq for delivery of my scooter as promised.

items.name: Wajhi Uddin Siddiqui
items.text: Excellent service provided by Shaukat and Vinit. Thanks, Aarush service team.

items.name: Mohd Dastagir Ahmed
items.text: Good service, well mannered staff. Very good response with Aarush Suzuki showroom Bahadurpura.

items.name: Syed Zameer Ibrahim
items.text: Best service spot for vehicle delivery and polite behaviour of staff. I recommend this showroom for all.

items.name: Mansoor Khan
items.text: Very polite and helpful staff with quick service and response.
